questions.question: Primary approach for making these two tests run against good data?

options.label: Generator + RefreshDatabase
options.description: Convert AclMatrixTest & SmokeTest to build their own fund/portfolio/asset graph via DataFactory/TestFixtures on a RefreshDatabase'd test DB. No reliance on ambient data. Requires regenerating golden acl_matrix.json. Cleanest, matches Feature tests.

options.label: Curated golden DB
options.description: Build a non-trivial seed DB (partly from cleaned dev data, orphans removed) used as the dedicated test DB. Less refactor, but a new artifact to maintain.

options.label: Investigate further first
options.description: Prototype the generator path on AclMatrixTest only, show you the diff/golden churn, then decide before touching SmokeTest.

questions.question: What to do with the defensive null-skip guards I already added (PortfolioAPIControllerExt + FundTrait x2)?

options.label: Revert them
options.description: Remove the `continue`-on-null guards entirely; rely solely on good test data so a real orphaned row would still surface as a 500.

options.label: Keep as hardening
options.description: Keep them so a production data glitch degrades gracefully instead of 500-ing a whole fund page, but fix the test data separately so tests still prove correctness.

options.label: Keep but log
options.description: Keep the guard but add a Log::warning when an orphaned portfolio_asset is skipped, so it's visible in prod rather than silent.

questions.question: Also clean the orphaned rows in the dev/stage DB itself (assets 166/182/183 referenced but missing)?

options.label: Yes, fix dev data too
options.description: Remove/repair the orphaned portfolio_assets in familyfund_dev so the shared dev DB is internally consistent, independent of the test refactor.

options.label: No, leave dev DB as-is
options.description: Only address the test data path; leave the dev DB untouched for now.
